items.claim: Portal authority and desktop workbench responsibilities are disjoint and machine-readable; portal-owned purchase, recovery, credential, and account workflows are not duplicated.
The native host opens only approved token-free app.thrallo.com destinations; devices, project status and cloud launch remain integration pending.
Companion summaries adapt account, plan, agent, build, preview, deployment, usage and integration contracts from their existing owners without a second business model.

Instructions, plan decisions, agent controls, alerts and high-impact reviews operate only through deterministic fixture delegates and require fresh state and explicit typed confirmation where applicable.

The shared renderer defines and tests mobile-small, mobile-large, tablet-portrait, tablet-landscape and narrow-desktop rules with 44px touch targets; browser-layout and real-device qualification remain unverified.
Production companion transport, mobile app, push notifications, portal return exchange, cloud launch and Builder V2 mutations remain unimplemented.
